description: Set (or clear) the title of a kanban row (lane). Lanes group columns into horizontal swimlanes; a lane is identified by its integer `lane` index (the same index columns carry). Pass a `title` to name the row, or an empty string to clear it. Read current lane titles + the shared column width via `list_tasks`.

access_key.description: 8-character lowercase alphanumeric board access key when the board is locked (legacy 6-character lowercase alphanumeric keys are also accepted). Equivalent to setting the `X-Board-Key` HTTP header on the JSON-RPC POST. Omit for unlocked boards. Obtain via POST /api/boards/<id>/lock.

title.description: Row title; empty string clears it.

name: set_lane
title: Set Lane
